```{r,echo=FALSE}
options(scipen=99)
P = sample(11:99,1)*10^sample(1:3,1)
r = sample(2:9,1)/100
t = sample(c(10,15,20,25,30),1)
n = sample(c(2,3,4,6,12,52),1)
A = signif(P*(1+r/n)^(n*t),3)
P = A/(1+r/n)^(n*t)

```

Question
========

An investment earns [compound interest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compound_interest#Periodic_compounding) with periodic compounding.

* Principal = ?
* Nominal [annual interest rate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annual_percentage_rate#Multiple_definitions_of_effective_APR) = $r~=~`r r` ~=~`r 100*r`\%$
* Compounding frequency = $n=`r n`$ per year
* Time = $t=`r t`$ years
* Future value = $A$ = \$`r A`

Calculate the principal, in USD, such that after `r t` years the amount equals \$`r A`, by using the formula below.

$$A = P\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}$$
You can round your answer to the nearest dollar. (*Tolerance is $\pm 1$*)

Solution
========

Solve for $P$ by dividing both sides by $\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}$.


$$\frac{A}{\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}} = P$$

Switch sides for standard form of a formula, so the isolated variable is on the left side.


$$P=\frac{A}{\left(1+\frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}}$$

Plug in the numbers.


$$P=\frac{`r A`}{\left(1+\frac{`r r`}{`r n`}\right)^{`r n`\cdot `r t`}}$$

Evaluate the expression.


$$P=`r P`$$

Round to the nearest dollar. $P=`r round(P)`$.
